say:1:1220513001:1.text: Miss, why did you come to the village gate?
say:1:1220513001:1.source_cn: 大婶，你怎么跑到村口来了？

say:3:1220513002:1.text: Just because I know how stubborn that old pig can be! Now that the village has calmed down, I thought I'd come and greet you.
say:3:1220513002:1.source_cn: 还不是因为这只猪脾气最倔！正好村里也安稳点了，我就想着...

say:4:1220513003:1.text: Thank you for helping me find them all! Now I can finally get some rest.
say:4:1220513003:1.source_cn: 多谢你们帮我找回它！现在我总算能安心歇一会儿了。

say:5:1220513004:1.text: Wait, don't forget to take this back! Your bell!
say:5:1220513004:1.source_cn: 啊，别忘记收好这个！你的铃铛！

say:6:1220513005:1.text: Ah... don't worry, I'll take care of it. It's a keepsake that reminds me of my husband and son...
say:6:1220513005:1.source_cn: 哎……不用担心，我会好好收着它的。不管怎么说，也是我丈...

choice_prompt:7:1220513005.text: Ah... don't worry, I'll take care of it. It's a keepsake that reminds me of my husband and son...
choice_prompt:7:1220513005.source_cn: 哎……不用担心，我会好好收着它的。不管怎么说，也是我丈夫和儿子留下来的遗物……

say:8:1220513006:1.text: It's been many years since they've moved on. I'm... fine.
say:8:1220513006:1.source_cn: ……都过去多少年了，我早就没事了。
say:8:1220513006:1.male: It's been many years since they've moved on. I'm... fine.
say:8:1220513006:1.female: It's been many years since they've moved on. I'm... fine.

say:9:1220513007:1.text: Besides, people like us, who live off the sea, are always prepared for the worst.
say:9:1220513007:1.source_cn: 再说了，我们这种靠海吃饭的人，早就知道会有这么一天。
say:9:1220513007:1.male: Besides, people like us, who live off the sea, are always prepared for the worst.
say:9:1220513007:1.female: Besides, people like us, who live off the sea, are always prepared for the worst.

say:11:1220513009:1.text: I'm sorry, we didn't mean to make you sad.
say:11:1220513009:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我们不是故意惹你伤心的……

say:12:1220513010:1.text: Yes, I'm sorry! Chippy didn't realize just how important this bell was to you.
say:12:1220513010:1.source_cn: 对、对不起！满满也不知道，这个铃铛对你这么重要……

say:13:1220513011:1.text: Oh, don't you be sorry! I made my peace long ago.
say:13:1220513011:1.source_cn: 行了，别往心里去！我早就接受现实了！

say:14:1220513012:1.text: But once in a while, when it's especially quiet... I still miss them.
say:14:1220513012:1.source_cn: 只不过，偶尔，很偶尔的时候……我还是会想他们。

say:16:1220513008:1.text: Oh, I hide nothing. I just... don't wish to become emotional.
say:16:1220513008:1.source_cn: 那可不是藏起来！不过是……我不想触景生情而已。
say:16:1220513008:1.male: Oh, I hide nothing. I just... don't wish to become emotional.
say:16:1220513008:1.female: Oh, I hide nothing. I just... don't wish to become emotional.

choice:7:1:2.text: You hide your pain so deeply.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 但你之前把它藏得很深
choice:7:1:2.male: You hide your pain so deeply.
choice:7:1:2.female: You hide your pain so deeply.
